body:
Brian is happy to speak about any of his books , especially his newest,

 Life After Doom (May 2024),

 Do I Stay Christian (August 2022),

 Faith After Doubt (January 2021)

 along with his short ebooks on Bias and Authoritarianism , and

 The Seventh Story Books – Cory and the Seventh Story ,

 The Seventh Story: Us, Them, and the End of Violence.

  

 A good format is a 35-40 minute lecture (usually with slides) followed by small group conversations and/or Q & R. He is happy to do multiple sessions in one day, and to pre-record sessions where that is appropriate.
